posts.author: FranzLascrea
posts.body: can anyone tell me what rpg maker is good for newbies and for low level devices?, i have 0 experience.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body: They're all good for newbies. Personally I would recommend either MV or MZ. If you're unsure if your device will work for them, check the system requirements.

posts.author: Mayden
posts.body: Hello! I personally use RPG Maker MV, which has enough options to make your very own game. You may also consider RPG Maker VX Ace, though it's a bit old and works differently. If you choose the MV enginee, I can recommend you some plugins to help you start!

posts.author: TeiRaven
posts.body:
Harlekin is right: any of the RPG Makers is good for beginners!
My first and favorite is XP, but I recognize that using an engine that's old enough to vote has some challenges built in XD It's Windows-only, but it will nearly run on a toaster as long as that toaster is Windows. And you can't beat the price--this time of year, it usually goes on sale for 2.50 USD.
For a newer engine, I would recommend MZ! It allows you to choose what size tiles you want to use, and the mapping system gives you a lot of freedom compared to the one in MV. However, since it's the newest, it is both the most expensive and requires the most powerful computer.
The only ones I would really recommend against are VX and VX Lite, because they're both quite restrictive compared to the others. VX Ace is of the same era and fixed many of the issues they had.
